name: Ultralight pilot (convicted; silhouette only)
depiction: The pilot who landed an ultralight carrying about 223 lb of marijuana near Marana, Arizona, in October 2008 and was caught by a CBP helicopter crew; he pleaded guilty and was sentenced to 33 months (Arizona Daily Star; AP). Drawn ONLY as a dark rim-lit silhouette (silhouette option): no face, no features; plain dark jacket. Never named. Not a likeness. Tagged NOT A LIKENESS.
